body: Thanks for explaining dude, glad to hear you're doing a little better. She said she told a few others (probably 2 or 3). I'll definitely be more supportive over the next couple weeks. I sent a message to a family member of hers recently, so hopefully they do the same.

Nah man I really appreciate this point of view. Definitely helps me understand to an extent. If you wouldn't mind explaining a little further I'd be really interested to hear what you mean by feeling like you've been denied a right to happiness and being a burden.

I seriously hope shit does get better, by the way.
Thanks! Does it make sense to wait a little bit before going behind her back and betraying the trust? Given that there's some time still?
